exposure: Number of embryos transferred during IVF (SET, DET, ≥3)
cohort: 116 patients who conceived with IVF and delivered at >20 weeks gestational age between 2007 and 2011
finding: Multiple embryo transfers during IVF were associated with increased rates of prematurity, cesarean delivery, and low birth weight, as well as higher healthcare costs.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery rates increased directly with the number of embryos transferred.
